hold_reason: Refund mismatch: Alpha Co W2 reported refunds applied for order_id 113 (7379 cents), 114 (8493 cents), and 115 (6651 cents), but list_refunds returns an empty ledger. Net balances computed now may overpay customers (acme, birch, cobalt), and payouts cannot be recalled. Needs human review to confirm whether the refunds were applied to the shared ledger before any payouts are recorded.
